loyalty_entries_sign_ck.name: loyalty_entries_sign_ck
loyalty_entries_sign_ck.value:
("loyalty_entries"."reason" = 'order_award' and "loyalty_entries"."delta" > 0 and "loyalty_entries"."expires_at" is not null)
        or ("loyalty_entries"."reason" in ('order_revoke', 'redemption', 'expiry') and "loyalty_entries"."delta" <= 0)
        or ("loyalty_entries"."reason" = 'adjustment' and "loyalty_entries"."delta" <> 0 and ("loyalty_entries"."delta" < 0 or "loyalty_entries"."expires_at" is not null))

loyalty_rewards_kind_ck.name: loyalty_rewards_kind_ck
loyalty_rewards_kind_ck.value: ("loyalty_rewards"."kind" = 'discount' and "loyalty_rewards"."value_cents" > 0) or ("loyalty_rewards"."kind" = 'bonus_item' and "loyalty_rewards"."game_id" is not null and "loyalty_rewards"."item_id" is not null)
